messages:
Ravi (Design): quick design question: for multi-row dashboards should each row default to its own y-scale or share across the row? I prototyped both.
Noor (Eng-Frontend): row-shared is easier to scan for comparisons. Per-row independent scales help reveal local variance.
Kai (DataViz): prefer shared by default, but show a subtle 'scaled' hint when rows are independent. also suggest a per-row toggle in the row header.
Evelyn (PM): default to shared for product clarity. power users can flip independent per-row. include copy explaining tradeoffs.
Ravi (Design): UI suggestion: row header includes "Scale: Shared ▾". clicking opens menu: Shared | Independent | Auto-clamp. Tooltip: "Shared keeps y consistent; Independent emphasizes local shape."
Noor (Eng-Frontend): accessibility notes: the menu must be keyboard operable, aria-expanded, and choices have role=menuitemradio. focus outline visible.
Kai (DataViz): outlier handling: propose 'auto-clamp' which clips top 0.5% and shows a chevron marker on clipped points. include "(n clipped)" in row summary.
Ravi (Design): visual: clipped region rendered as a faint hashed band on the axis and chevron overlay on points. microcopy: "Value clipped for readability. Click to expand."
A11yBot: reminder: any interactive element must have accessible names and aria-live updates when toggles change. Tracking ticket #512.
Noor (Eng-Frontend): backend change: add series_summary to /dash/rows API with {clipped_count, clamp_threshold}. will sample to avoid heavy compute.
Evelyn (PM): release plan: expose Scale menu + clamp visuals in beta. collect feedback via an in-dashboard survey. add a11y review before GA.
Ravi (Design): i'll update mocks for desktop and mobile (compact menu) and add states for keyboard focus. will post updated PNGs here. :sparkles:
